_comment: Declarative model registry for model.gateway. The gateway resolves a requested model (by -Model id, -Tier alias, or the default) against `models`, and runs it if `wired` and its type/engine are supported (MVP: type=llm via engine=llama-server). Non-wired / non-LLM entries are DECLARED so later modules can wire them without rediscovering the machine. Paths point at portable per-owning-module copies under LifeOrchestrator-Refresh_Large_Data\<NN>-<module>\ (relocated out of the staging area into owning-module homes 2026-07-25; shared llama.cpp engine under _engines\). To swap which model a tier uses, change `tiers`/`defaults` below — no code change.

engines._comment: Staged, verified to run standalone (health + chat) 2026-07-24. Depends on a system CUDA runtime (not on the source folder). If torn down, restage from F:\Qwen3.5-27B\llama.cpp\build\bin.

models.name: Qwen3.5-9B
models.notes: Strong tier upgraded to Qwen3.5-9B Q5_K_M 2026-07-28 (plan fo-9-d4139304, worker Q5-stage) per the couriered frontier model-selection report: SAME Qwen3.5-9B (bartowski GGUF), quant Q4_K_M -> Q5_K_M (~7.11 GB) for better fidelity WITH real KV headroom on the 11 GB RTX 2080 Ti (ngl 99, fully resident). engine_path stays llama.cpp b10092 (hybrid attention-SSM arch b8661 cannot load); no_think true; context 8192 kept IDENTICAL to the prior Q4 so the orchestrator S0 6/6 calibration is apples-to-apples (Q5 KV headroom permits 16K later). Prior Q4_K_M retained as llm.strong.qwen3p5-9b-q4 (wired:false) for rollback. STAGED + repointed but PENDING the orchestrator live S0 6/6 calibration + a strong-tier smoke gen. The 27B (llm.strong.qwen3p5-27b) remains retained but impractical GPU-bound on 11 GB.

models.name: Qwen3.5-9B
models.notes: Demoted 2026-07-28 (Q5_K_M strong upgrade, worker Q5-stage / plan fo-9-d4139304). Prior Q4_K_M strong tier, RETAINED (wired:false so the gateway wired-LLM count stays 5) for rollback: revert by copying this entry path/quant/version/params back into llm.strong.qwen3p5-9b (re-wire this entry to pin -Model it directly). Same engine b10092, ngl 99, ctx 8192, no_think.

models.name: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Fastest; smoke tests / trivial labeling. Fully GPU-offloaded on the RTX 2080 Ti.

models.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.notes: Default weak tier: bulk classification/labeling/extraction. Fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct
models.notes: Mid tier: harder labeling; still fully GPU-offloaded.

models.name: Qwen3.5-27B
models.notes: Strong tier: review/adjudication (Module 9). ~16 GB Q4 > 11 GB VRAM, so PARTIAL GPU offload. Tuned by Module 9 (2026-07-24): swept gpu_layers {20,28,36} on an idle GPU — all loaded (no OOM), throughput monotonic 1.43/1.67/1.93 tok/s; raised 28 -> 32 (strictly fewer layers than the 36 that fit, so it fits with headroom for desktop display VRAM). Cold first load ~90s (16 GB read from F:), warm ~7-9s (OS cache); callers should pass a longer load timeout for a cold strong load (review.processor -LoadTimeoutSec). Still slow (~2 tok/s) — reserve for the hardest items.

models.name: Whisper base.en (ggml)
models.notes: Consumed by speech.stt (Module 11), which reads this entry's path + engine_candidates directly. Still wired:false for model.gateway on purpose — the gateway MVP runs type=llm only, so it correctly returns model_not_wired for STT. whisper.cpp CLI (CUDA + CPU builds) verified 2026-07-24 (m11-probe-001/002); live base.en transcription passed 27/27 via the executor (m11-test-001).

models.name: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice
models.notes: Consumed by speech.tts (Module 11's sibling, Module 12), which reads this entry's path + engine_env directly. Still wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway MVP runs type=llm only). Default weak TTS voice. Runs under the speech venv (torch 2.11+cu128, transformers 4.57.3, qwen_tts). Verified 2026-07-24 (m12-probe-002 live synthesis; m12-test-001 27→25/25). English speakers Ryan/Aiden; 24 kHz mono output.

models.name: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice
models.notes: Consumed by speech.tts (Module 12) as the strong tier (-Tier strong / -Model tts.strong.qwen3-1p7b). Still wired:false for model.gateway (type=llm only). Stronger TTS voice; runs under the speech venv. Slower per-call load (3.8 GB); reserve for higher-quality synthesis.

models.name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
models.notes: DECLARED only. Discovered under an ACE-Step music suite; copied for portability. Wire in Module 23 (artifact.search). Could also run via llama.cpp llama-server --embedding if converted to GGUF.

models.name: Windows.Media.Ocr (system)
models.notes: Consumed by ocr.layout (Module 14), which runs Windows.Media.Ocr in a Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker (pwsh 7 cannot load the WinRT projection — m14-probe-001) and reads its meta file. System WinRT engine: no model file, no GPU, no network; en-US recognizer present; MaxImageDimension=10000. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only). Verified live 2026-07-25 (m14-probe-001 words+boxes+lines+angle ~74 ms; m14-test-001).

models.name: Tesseract OCR
models.notes: DECLARED only. Installed (found by m14-probe-001). A future ocr.layout engine: calibrated per-word confidence + hOCR/TSV boxes + multi-language. Not wired in the Module 14 MVP (only windows.media.ocr).

models.name: YOLOX-Nano (COCO-80)
models.notes: Consumed by detect.objects (Module 16), which runs the ONNX model via onnxruntime in a Python worker (detect_worker.py) under this engine_env (the system python; onnxruntime-gpu 1.17.1) and reads its meta file. Default CPU execution provider -> no GPU/port binding, so detect.objects is parallel_safe. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only). Staged to F: + verified live 2026-07-25 (m16-probe-001: CPU provider load + dog/car/bicycle on the committed fixture, identical to the cloud box). YOLOX letterbox-416 preproc, strides {8,16,32}, obj*cls score, class-aware NMS; real per-detection confidence. Apache-2.0 (Megvii YOLOX).

models.name: YOLOX-Tiny (COCO-80)
models.notes: Second detector tier (-Tier tiny). Same YOLOX topology/decode as nano but more accurate (~5M params). Apache-2.0 (Megvii YOLOX). A drop-in for detect.objects with no code change; if the F: file is absent, detect.objects returns a clean model_file_not_found.

models.name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (GGUF)
models.notes: Consumed by image.interpret (Module 17), which runs this GGUF + its mmproj projector via the staged llama.cpp llama-server (b8661, multimodal build) - launch -m <path> --mmproj <mmproj> -c 8192 -ngl 99, then POST /v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style image_url base64 data URI. Fully GPU-offloaded on the RTX 2080 Ti (~3.1 GB weights + image tokens, ~111 tok/s). wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only; image.interpret reads this entry itself, decoupled from the wired gate like ocr.layout/detect.objects). Downloaded from ggml-org/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-GGUF and staged to F: + load-and-caption verified live 2026-07-25 (m17-probe-002/003). Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen). A 7B tier and a transformers-venv backend are documented follow-ons.

models.name: Stable Diffusion 1.5 (diffusers fp16)
models.notes: Consumed by gen.image (Module 23), which runs this diffusers folder via the StableDiffusionPipeline (fp16, CUDA) in a Python worker (gen_image_infer.py) under this engine_env (the speech venv; diffusers 0.35.2 + torch 2.11+cu128) and reads its meta file. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only; gen.image reads this entry itself, decoupled from the wired gate like speech.tts/image.interpret). Downloaded from stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp16 variant) and staged to F: + load-and-generate verified live 2026-07-25 (m23-probe-002: 512x512 in 2.8 s, VRAM peak 2.61 GB, non-blank). CreativeML OpenRAIL-M. FLUX.1-schnell (Apache-2.0, needs offload on 11 GB) and SDXL/SDXL-Turbo are documented follow-on tiers. SD 3.5 Medium (image.sd35-medium) is the higher-quality diffusers-native tier alongside this fast legacy default (i17).

models.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium (diffusers fp16)
models.license: STABILITY-AI-COMMUNITY (free under $1M annual revenue -- PRESERVE this note)
models.notes: Consumed by gen.image (Module 23) as the SD 3.5 Medium QUALITY tier alongside the SD 1.5 fast legacy tier (defaults.image stays image.sd15). Diffusers-native StableDiffusion3Pipeline (fp16, CUDA) in gen_image_infer.py under this engine_env (speech venv: diffusers 0.35.2 + torch 2.11+cu128) with a meta-file hand-off; params.pipeline='sd3' selects that branch. Turing RTX 2080 Ti cc7.5 -> FP16 ONLY (no bf16/fp8/nf4). VRAM strategy: enable_model_cpu_offload() + enable_vae_tiling(), T5-XXL text encoder stays CPU-side (offload streams it, never resident); on the 11 GB card the worker's safety ladder retries enable_sequential_cpu_offload() on CUDA OOM. Native FlowMatchEuler scheduler (the SD1.5 dpm++/euler swap does NOT apply to SD3). wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (gateway runs type=llm only; gen.image reads this entry itself, like image.sd15). Staged from the gated stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-medium (Stability Community License) to F: as a diffusers folder: transformer 4.94 GB + T5-XXL fp16 9.52 GB (sharded) + CLIP-G 1.39 GB + CLIP-L 0.25 GB + VAE 0.17 GB ~= 16.27 GB core; the 5.1 GB single-file checkpoint and the ComfyUI text_encoders/ duplicates were NOT staged. LIVE-VERIFY (i17): TODO_FILL measured VRAM + gen time + artifact. Follow-ons: Z-Image-Turbo Q8 (needs stable-diffusion.cpp -- separate wave); img2img/inpaint/ControlNet/upscaling/LoRA; num_images>1 batch/grids; a warm/persistent pipeline worker.

models.name: MusicGen Small (transformers)
models.notes: Consumed by gen.music (Module 24), which runs this MusicGen model via transformers MusicgenForConditionalGeneration (CUDA) in a Python worker (music_gen_infer.py) under this engine_env (the speech venv; transformers 4.57.3 + torch 2.11+cu128 + soundfile) and reads its meta file. Produces one 32 kHz mono instrumental clip; a non-wav format/rate is produced by composing audio.ingest (#10). wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only; gen.music reads this entry itself, decoupled from the wired gate like speech.tts/image.interpret/gen.image). Downloaded from facebook/musicgen-small and staged to F: (~2.37 GB after pruning the redundant audiocraft-format weights; safetensors sha256 recorded) + load-and-generate verified live 2026-07-25 (m24-probe-002: 5.06 s clip in 7.6 s, VRAM peak 2.4 GB, seed byte-reproducible). NO new library install (transformers already ships MusicGen). CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial; a deliberate deviation from the Apache-2.0 preference, precedented by SD 1.5's OpenRAIL-M in gen.image). MusicGen Medium/Large and Stable Audio Open are documented follow-on tiers; MusicgenMelody (melody-conditioned) is a follow-on.

models.name: AnimateDiff-Lightning 4-step (SD 1.5)
models.notes: Consumed by gen.video (Module 25), which runs a diffusers AnimateDiffPipeline via a Python worker (video_gen_infer.py) under this engine_env (the speech venv; diffusers 0.35.2 + torch 2.11+cu128). It composes the AnimateDiff-Lightning 4-step MotionAdapter (this entry's 'adapter', downloaded from ByteDance/AnimateDiff-Lightning, animatediff_lightning_4step_diffusers.safetensors, ~907 MB) ON TOP OF the Stable Diffusion 1.5 base ('base', reused from gen.image #23) -- MotionAdapter().load_state_dict(load_file(adapter)) + AnimateDiffPipeline.from_pretrained(base, motion_adapter=..., torch_dtype=fp16, variant='fp16', local_files_only=True), EulerDiscreteScheduler(trailing/linear), enable_vae_slicing, .to('cuda'). Produces one short silent clip; MP4 via the present ffmpeg (H.264) or GIF via Pillow. wired:false for model.gateway on purpose (the gateway runs type=llm only; gen.video reads this entry itself, decoupled from the wired gate like speech.tts/image.interpret/gen.image/gen.music). Downloaded + staged to F: + load-and-generate verified live 2026-07-26 (m25-probe-002: 16 frames 512x512 4-step in ~57 s warm, VRAM peak 4.75 GB full-GPU -- no offload, pixel_std 44.4 / mean interframe diff 41.6, seed byte-reproducible). NO new library install (diffusers already present; MP4 via ffmpeg). License CreativeML-OpenRAIL-M -- the same license as the SD 1.5 base (a precedented local-generation deviation, D-0034). AnimateDiff full 25-step / SVD image-to-video / CogVideoX / LTX (bf16, need newer HW) are documented follow-on tiers. See D-0036.
